OPTION 1: S3 + CloudFront (Multi-Site with CDN)
RECOMMENDED
Best for: Production-ready, fast global delivery with HTTPS and custom domains
Cost: $15-40/month for all 10 sites

Key points:
- Create 10 S3 buckets (one per site) with static website hosting disabled and private access
- Use CloudFront distributions (one per site) to serve content over HTTPS
- CloudFront provides SSL/TLS certificates via ACM at no extra cost
- Route 53 for custom domain management (if needed)
- Benefits: Global CDN caching, built-in DDoS protection, better performance, custom domains with SSL
- S3 storage: approximately 0.023/GB/month (10GB total = $0.23/month)
- CloudFront: 1TB data transfer free tier, then $0.085/GB, minimal request fees
- Good for SOC 2: encryption in transit (HTTPS), CloudFront access logs, S3 server access logs
- Tradeoff: Slightly more complex setup but production-grade
